This screenshot shows a single icon on a plain background — not a full app or website interface.

**Details:**

- **Background:** Solid black (or very dark, near-black) square filling the entire image.

- **Icon:** A "magic wand" or "AI sparkle" style icon rendered in a gradient of golden/tan colors (light cream-gold fading to a darker tan/bronze). It consists of two elements:
  1. A **vertical wand** — a long rounded rectangle (pill shape) positioned on the left side of the icon, extending from near the top to near the bottom, with rounded ends at top and bottom.
  2. A **four-pointed sparkle/star** — a diamond-shaped star with curved concave edges (like a "twinkle" or "sparkle" symbol), positioned to the right of the wand, overlapping its upper-right area.

- **Text:** There is no text visible in the image.

- **What it likely represents:** This type of wand-and-sparkle icon is commonly used to represent **AI/magic features** — e.g., "AI assist," "auto-enhance," "smart editing," or generative AI tools. Similar icons appear in apps like Google Photos, Gemini, Notion AI, or photo editors for "magic" tools. It resembles a "magic wand / auto-fix" icon found in design and editing applications.

There are no other icons, buttons, menus, or interface elements visible — just this one golden sparkle-wand icon centered on the black background.
